newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Zion 1 power unit reduced to 44 pct.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Zion 1 power unit reduced to 44 pct.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 1,040 megawatt (MW) Zion 1 nuclear power unit has been reduced to 44 percent of capacity, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday in its morning status report.
The company is "determining whether to begin coastdown to refueling outage," the NRC report stated.
The unit, in Zion, Ill., was operating at full power on Monday.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, remains shut for refueling, which is expected to end in the next few days.
ComEd is a subsidiary of UCM Corp.
